g.text: The customer opens a return from the order page and picks a reason.
Support checks the delivery date and the reason.
Support emails a prepaid shipping label.
The customer ships the item within 14 days.
The warehouse inspects the item within 2 working days.
Finance refunds the original payment method. Support closes the ticket.
The customer opens a return after 30 days.
Support rejects the request and emails the reason.
The item is damaged. Support emails the reason, and the warehouse ships the item back.
